derived_code: rain_sum=sum(rain); apr_oct = months 4-10 (index 3..9); apr_oct_mean = mean of printed monthly daily means; mean_alt_diff = Barolo terrain mean 295 m minus Barbaresco 237 m (atlas terrain e[1]); computed in Python in this run.

disciplinare.source: Regione Piemonte, disciplinare Barbaresco DOCG, last amendment DM 17.04.2015
disciplinare.art3: whole communes of Barbaresco, Neive, Treiso plus part of frazione San Rocco Seno d'Elvio (now in Alba), province of Cuneo
disciplinare.art4: vineyards not above 550 m; max 8 t/ha (7.2 with MGA + vigna); min natural alcohol 12.00% vol
disciplinare.art5: Barbaresco 26 months, 9 in wood, from 1 Nov of harvest year, release 1 Jan of 3rd year; Riserva 50 months, 9 in wood, release 1 Jan of 5th year
disciplinare.art7: 66 menzioni geografiche aggiuntive (count of names in art. 7 comma 1)

study.text: The zone is lower and closer to the Tanaro, so it is a little warmer and Nebbiolo ripens slightly earlier. MGA such as Rabajà may appear on the label.
